analysis_notes: The predicate os.name == nt at line 195 (inside supportedDeviceEnumerator) backward-slices entirely to the Python stdlib os module name attribute, which is set at CPython interpreter startup based on the host OS kernel. There are no intermediate assignments: os is imported at module level (line 25) and os.name is read directly. No CLI argument, YAML key, environment variable, or other Tensile user-facing input influences os.name. The sole public input is the OS kernel type itself, tagged os. The predicate is True only on Windows NT; on Linux/macOS (posix) it is always False and the function returns _supportedComponent with rocm_agent_enumerator and amdgpu-arch. The Windows branch with hipinfo/hipInfo is unreachable on POSIX hosts without monkeypatching. The existing char test pins the posix branch; the Windows branch is documented as resistance.
